ops.title: Port the install-binary detach + atomic-relink fix to cc-context's diverged local fragment
ops.description: cc-skills `99f9f0b` made the shared install-binary fragments (`plugin/guides/sh/install-binary-{pinned,latest}.sh`) exit immediately when `$LINK` already resolves to a working binary, detaching the refresh (`sh "$0" --sync </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 &`), and made `$LINK` relinks rename-atomic via a `relink()` helper (bare `ln -sf` can ENOENT a concurrent caller's exec). cc-review/cc-present/slop-cop/codex consume the shared or already-patched fragments; **cc-context does not** — its `.claude/fragments/plugin/scripts/install-binary.sh/install-binary.fragment.sh` is a diverged local copy with its own `BREW_LOCK` mechanism, a pre-v0.5.0 bootstrap-shim migration sweep, and versioned-payload cleanup, so it was not covered and its `scripts/mcp.sh` still blocks the ccx MCP handshake on the full refresh (30s connect timeout kills the toolset for the session — see the cc-review note `dbefea0c` for the incident this caused). Port both behaviors into the diverged body, respecting its brew-lock flow (a lock *wait* still blocks the caller today), and re-render.

ops.text: With a stale-but-working ccx at $LINK and a brew stubbed to sleep 60, the rendered install-binary.sh exits 0 in under 1s and a detached child performs the refresh
First-run (no binary) and broken-binary (no version output) paths remain foreground
All $LINK relinks go through a rename-atomic helper (temp symlink + mv -f)
Rendered plugin/scripts/install-binary.sh on cc-context main contains the change
